hypotheses.title: Threshold Sensitivity Variation
hypotheses.explanation: Warning shortfalls arise due to detection thresholds calibrated for typical fault progressions missing late-developing or subtle fault signature variations in some traces.
hypotheses.alternative: Input noise or dropout disrupts continuity of signals, causing late or missed warnings independent of threshold settings.

hypotheses.title: Input Dropout Impact
hypotheses.explanation: Persistent dropout faults reduce effective feature values, leading to model uncertainty or failure to produce early warnings in affected histories.
hypotheses.alternative: Model thresholds or scoring do not robustly handle signal dropouts, and adjusting thresholds alone might not recover timely warnings.

gaps: No explicit metadata on model threshold settings and adjustments across channels.
Lack of detailed timing data for late warnings distinguishing threshold issues from input dropout effects.

next_tests.title: Threshold Adjustment Robustness Test
next_tests.procedure: Simulate a controlled sweep of detection thresholds on development data for patterns with late warnings, comparing warning timing and detection fraction.
next_tests.expected_signal: Improvement in timely warnings with lowered thresholds suggests threshold sensitivity causes warning shortfalls.
next_tests.if_signal_observed: Threshold calibration inadequacy is plausible; model decisions likely threshold-bound.
next_tests.if_signal_absent: Input dropout or feature corruption likely primary cause, as altered thresholds do not improve timing.

next_tests.title: Input Dropout Robustness Replay
next_tests.procedure: Replay fault traces with synthetic dropout events replaced by median-imputed values or flag indicators to test model response changes on dropout patterns.
next_tests.expected_signal: Restoration of timely warnings after input imputation or additional dropout flags indicates dropout handling weakness.
next_tests.if_signal_observed: Input dropout limits feature availability causing late/missed warnings; improving input handling may help.
next_tests.if_signal_absent: Warning shortfalls stem from other mechanisms such as thresholding or fault severity variation not dropout alone.
